messages:
Elena (Partnerships): Quick sync 1: LangChain + DataFlow want a co-bundled connector (LangChain orchestrator + DataFlow indexer) exposed via our gateway and an optional LlamaIndex adapter. We need owners for: bundle SKU + marketplace tile, certification CI (compat tests), SI enablement playbook, HW perf validation, and coannounce assets. Can we take roles?
Tom (Eng-Platform): I can own certification CI and the staging helm. Please share the connector repo and a sample docker-compose or helm chart.
Sam (Product): I'll own the bundle SKU and billing mapping. Draft SKU: BNDL-LC-DF-001 (trial -> reserved). Will add multi-vendor attribution field.
Asha (Eng-ML): I'll own HW perf + tokenization parity across models. We'll need quantized runner images for SigmaEdge and EdgeNode; ask partners to provide INT8 images or build instructions.
Ben (Marketplace): I'll draft the marketplace tile with a combined short/long description and a vendor list. Question: should the listing show separate SKUs for the optional LlamaIndex adapter?
Priya (LangChain PM): We can provide the connector images + example orchestration repo: https://drive.example/lc-dataflow/bundle. Also including compat matrix: streaming true, tools true, auth: api_key by default.
Rachel (Marketing): I'll draft coannounce assets: short blog, 45s microvideo demo, and an invite-only webinar. Need partner quotes + logos and an embargo window.
Tom (Eng-Platform): CI matrix I plan to run: endpoints (POST /v1/generate, /v1/call), streaming:true/false, function-calls, kv-cache behavior, auth modes (api_key/mTLS). Also will pin connectors to compat_tag to avoid breaking changes.
Asha (Eng-ML): Perf plan: gbench sizes small=64, med=512, large=2048. Will collect p50/p95 and tokenization diffs. Request autoscale off on sandbox cluster.
Ben (Marketplace): Marketplace manifest WIP:
```
name: "Redwood: LangChain + DataFlow Bundle (beta)"
sku: BNDL-LC-DF-001
availability: "Private pilot, request access"
add_ons: ["LLamaIndex-adapter"]
```
Sam (Product): I'll coordinate with finance for an enterprise trial SKU for SI partners. Also need legal guidance on co-selling revenue split.
Priya (LangChain PM): We uploaded logos and a short one-pager: https://drive.example/lc-dataflow/assets. ETA EOD Tue. Also note: compat_tag lc-0.38 for this bundle.
ops-bot: Preview deploy scheduled: lc-df-bundle-preview -> staging at 2030-06-15T12:00Z (deploy id: dp_bundle_555).
Tom (Eng-Platform): After preview I'll run the smoke compat tests and post results to https://git.internal/redwood/partnerships/lc-df-bundle. Ping this thread when deploy completes.
Asha (Eng-ML): I'll prepare gbench configs and expected bounds, plus a token-diff tool script. Will need access to two HW nodes from SigmaEdge team for validation window T+3 to T+10.
Rachel (Marketing): Timeline proposal: assets in T+2, staging + smoke T+4, legal signoff T+7, invite webinar T+12, public announce T+21. Who can own legal loop?
Elena (Partnerships): I'll coordinate legal review and the partner co-marketing agreement. Quick recap of owners: Sam (SKU), Tom (CI/deploy), Asha (HW perf/SI runbook), Ben (marketplace tile), Rachel (comms), Priya (partner assets). I'll send a calendar invite and a short checklist doc. Thanks all! :rocket:
